technical.summary: Bullish momentum with strong price structure and Hull MA flip, but overbought oscillators and weak intermediate MA alignment limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ALL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 69 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 10) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed/stale (104+ days old) with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (372.16) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 69 days poses minimal near-term binary risk but macro stress dominates.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull MA flip + three white soldiers + DC20 new high provide strong short-term momentum structure, and extreme fear (VIX 372) creates contrarian buy opportunity for risk-tolerant traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (stoch, Williams %R, stochRSI), zero fundamental support, weak intermediate MA alignment, unfavourable macro (VIX crisis, negative yield curve, high credit spreads), and price below 50/200 EMAs eliminate conviction for swing entry.
